audit: Jackin Docker, image builder, optional engine, and cleanup source audit
evidence_kind: pinned source inspection only; no runtime PASS

entries.action: Constructs host Bollard client and dispatches load, console, lifecycle, prune and restore workflows
entries.user_outcome: Start, reconnect, stop/remove, restore and prune agent instances
entries.owner_now: Jackin host process and host Docker engine
entries.replacement: Jackin retains command/product logic; OpenShell owns sandbox execution/lifecycle; host Docker remains separate image builder
entries.next_proof: Per-command OpenShell lifecycle and error behavior

entries.action: Endpoint resolution plus generic Docker container/image/volume/network/exec/pause API
entries.caller: Runtime, image service, cleanup, console and workflows
entries.user_outcome: Host Docker is used as agent execution and optional engine control plane
entries.replacement: Replace agent runtime operations with OpenShell control; retain isolated builder interface; keep only approved optional engine operations
entries.next_proof: Map every DockerApi method to a migrated callsite or prove safe removal

entries.action: Selects/reuses/pulls/builds role base and selected-agent-derived image at launch
entries.user_outcome: Selected agent and role tools installed before sandbox creation
entries.owner_now: Jackin image service, host Docker Buildx and role source
entries.replacement: Preserve launch-time build; record digest and deliver image to gateway with explicit platform/image transfer

entries.action: Runs docker run --rm --entrypoint <agent> <image> --version unless installer supplied version metadata
entries.user_outcome: Caches agent semver for diagnostics/update decisions; probe failure skips check
entries.owner_now: Jackin image service and host daemon
entries.replacement: Consume installer metadata or use explicitly commanded short-lived OpenShell probe; no implicit ENTRYPOINT assumption
entries.next_proof: Version parsing and fallback for every selected agent installation path

entries.action: Explicit/background image warm and freshness validation
entries.user_outcome: Reduced launch latency and reuse of matching images
entries.owner_now: Jackin prewarm policy and host builder cache
entries.replacement: Keep cache decision in Jackin; all resulting sandboxes remain OpenShell-owned
entries.next_proof: Cold/warm timings, stale image refresh, competing-client single adoption if retained

entries.action: Creates/starts role container, configures mounts/env/network/resources/grants, firewall/sudo setup, persists identity and attaches session
entries.user_outcome: Isolated agent runtime and interactive session
entries.replacement: OpenShell sandbox create/exec/PTY and policy; Jackin retains hooks/session product logic
entries.next_proof: Combined role/account/session/workspace journey and fail-closed hook behavior

entries.action: Profile preflight and debug Docker security-options diagnostic
entries.user_outcome: Profile readiness and optional AppArmor diagnostic
entries.owner_now: Jackin profile logic and Docker driver
entries.replacement: Jackin selects product profile; OpenShell driver is authority for actual enforcement/reporting
entries.next_proof: Allowed and denied operation plus bounded resource enforcement per profile/driver

entries.action: Creates dedicated network, sidecar engine, TLS certificate volume, endpoint and waits for readiness when Docker grant enabled
entries.caller: Role launch with explicit Docker profile
entries.owner_now: Jackin host Docker daemon owns DinD container/network/cert volume; child engine owns child resources
entries.replacement: Dedicated engine behind explicit sandbox grant; default off; specify separate engine owner and lifecycle
entries.next_proof: Default-off denial and complete dedicated TLS Docker/Compose/Testcontainers workflow

entries.action: Prewarms sidecar/network/cert volume, retains identity, checks labels; also includes v1-to-v2 legacy state conversion
entries.replacement: If kept, retain state and single-owner adoption with new engine design; fresh-reset scope excludes legacy v1 import
entries.next_proof: Concurrent adoption and persisted engine reconnect/teardown if retained

entries.action: Discovers labeled resources, resolves immutable handle, checks role absent, deletes sidecar/cert volume/network
entries.user_outcome: Avoids orphaned Docker resources and protects live role resources
entries.replacement: OpenShell removes sandbox; explicitly named engine owner removes engine, children, certs, networks, ports and state; Jackin removes retained data
entries.next_proof: Interrupted provision, idempotent cleanup, stop/start/delete ownership inventory

entries.action: Lists jk_* images, skips those referenced by role containers, removes unused images
entries.owner_now: Jackin CLI and Docker image store
entries.replacement: Retain only for Jackin-owned local builder cache; remote image cache cleanup requires documented gateway ownership/API
entries.next_proof: Safe prune with active references across each target

entries.action: Prunes sandbox-related runtime entries and retained host home/role/cache data; Docker inventory helps detect stale instances
entries.user_outcome: Reclaims instance and retained state while honoring holds
entries.replacement: OpenShell identity/state for runtime presence; Jackin stays owner of retained host data and purge policy
entries.next_proof: Separate runtime delete from state purge; byte-exact export/retention proof

entries.action: Resolves hardline/reconnect context using Docker inventory and status
entries.replacement: Retain console/selection; query OpenShell by gateway identity and immutable sandbox ID
entries.next_proof: Two gateway inventory/status/event attribution and stale target protection

entries.action: Scans Jackin-managed Docker role containers to decide host keep-awake state
entries.user_outcome: Host stays awake while active work requires it
entries.replacement: Retain host responsibility, query Jackin-owned OpenShell instances
entries.next_proof: macOS sleep behavior against OpenShell inventory

entries.action: Pulls/runs Docker verification sandbox, executes commands, returns output and removes container
entries.replacement: Decide retained host utility vs OpenShell execution; do not piggyback on optional agent Docker grant
entries.next_proof: Actual workflow result, source access, cancellation, output and cleanup

entries.action: Checks local daemon connectivity/version before selected actions
entries.replacement: Separate gateway/driver/image access prerequisite from build-only daemon and optional engine
entries.next_proof: Fresh gateway/bootstrap and clear unsupported prerequisite failure

entries.action: Installs Docker CLI/Buildx/Compose in construct image and builds/publishes role base image
entries.caller: Role image build and release pipeline
entries.user_outcome: Role tooling and published base image
entries.replacement: Preserve required CLI tools in role image; separate tool presence from engine grant; retain/update image release pipeline
entries.next_proof: Inspect final derived image and test that default sandbox lacks usable Docker credentials/endpoint

entries.action: Compiles/tests Docker consumers, publishes artifacts and declares dependency graph
entries.replacement: Update CI to exercise OpenShell-supported contracts; preserve generic build tooling; migrate individual consumers before dependency deletion

excluded_match_classes.reason: Fake clients/recorded Docker command assertions establish source intent, not production callsites or actual runtime evidence

excluded_match_classes.class: construct image build, xtask, Docker Bake, CI/release
excluded_match_classes.reason: Build/release tooling or validation; retain/classify separately from runtime adapters

excluded_match_classes.class: generic command runner, log wording, labels and telemetry names
excluded_match_classes.reason: No Docker engine operation by itself

limitations: No execution performed in this audit.
Some callsite source references are summarized by production workflow; exact exhaustive DockerApi implementation matches are preserved in raw index.
Some cleanup module ranges require final parent cross-check.
No legacy Docker-state import is designed because the requested rewrite uses fresh state reset.
